name: second-brain-kit
description: Notes and a work list for Claude Code, set up by Claude (not an official Anthropic plugin). Basic: one main session in a numbered notes folder, a work list Claude keeps, a done-check that logs and safety hooks that ask before deleting or uploading. Claude suggests extra parts (topic sessions, reminders, another-AI split) one by one from where you get stuck, and you confirm; a weekly check offers more on pain signals, only with your yes. Needs a Claude plan that includes Claude Code.
